review_scope: Maker inspection, not independent QA or approval

inspected_frames.observation: Paired paddle blades remain broad and separate on flattened sprays. Woody ascending framework, sparse vase-like crown, quiet lower trunk and root flare preserved.
Opposite view retains open branching; small blade reduction has not detached foliage or changed branching hypothesis. No coincident exposed face artifact observed.
Edge-on leaf planes remain supported by sloping branches. Overall height, lower trunk and roots visually unchanged; this view alone does not show blade width.
Layered leaf sprays are thin from this side but have real volume and attached bases. No broken twig or visible gap at attachment.
Whole rooted tree remains upright, crown airy rather than fern rosette or flowered tree. Outline remains complete within frame.
Broad six-paired blades and gaps between spray groups remain readable. Normal leaf overlap remains; no geometry or visual claim of zero overlap is made.
Neutral override retains blade volume and all structural branches/root/scar geometry. No texture, transparency or depth-bias workaround hides the repair.
Full tree and root silhouette fit in frame. Leaf-sized gaps remain, no clipped crown or detached component appears.
